lines.zh: 冰面裂开一道缝，我从中滑过。
lines.en: A seam opens in the ice, and I slide through.

lines.zh: 我的甲上结着霜，走一路掉一路。
lines.en: Frost coats my shell and falls with every step.

lines.zh: 我在冻土下走，雪面鼓起一道白脊。
lines.en: I move under the frozen soil, lifting a white ridge.

lines.zh: 节缝里的冰互相摩擦，发出细响。
lines.en: Ice in my joints grinds with a thin sound.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，雪变成了冰。
lines.en: Where I pass, the snow turns to ice.

lines.zh: 冷雾跟着我，像一条尾巴。
lines.en: Cold mist trails behind me like a tail.

lines.zh: 我贴地挪动，把雪压成硬壳。
lines.en: I creep along and press the snow into crust.

lines.zh: 冰虫没有脚，只有向前的力气。
lines.en: An iceworm has no legs, only forward force.

lines.zh: 我绕过冰柱，不碰那东西。
lines.en: I go around the ice pillars and never touch them.

lines.zh: 雪落在我的背上，没有化。
lines.en: Snow settles on my back and does not melt.

lines.zh: 我走得很轻，冰面几乎不响。
lines.en: I walk lightly, and the ice barely speaks.

lines.zh: 寒气从我身上散开，草都白了。
lines.en: Cold spreads off me, and the grass goes white.

lines.zh: 我沉下去，又从另一处顶开冰。
lines.en: I sink, then push up through the ice elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我走成一圈，把猎物圈在中间。
lines.en: I trace a ring and close my prey inside it.

lines.zh: 我在冰下拐弯，雪面跟着鼓。
lines.en: I turn under the ice and the snow bulges with me.

lines.zh: 我把身下的雪压实，慢慢滑。
lines.en: I pack the snow beneath me and slide on.

lines.zh: 我盘在冰窝里，一动不散。
lines.en: I coil in an ice hollow and hold still.

lines.zh: 霜从我的节缝长出来，很慢。
lines.en: Frost grows from my seams, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我张口，吐出的气是白的。
lines.en: I open my mouth, and white breath comes out.

lines.zh: 冰面下很安静，我听着。
lines.en: It is quiet under the ice, and I listen.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处泛着蓝光。
lines.en: My eyes glow blue in the dark.

lines.zh: 雪堆到我的背上，我不抖。
lines.en: Snow piles on my back, and I do not shake it.

lines.zh: 我在等，等得很耐心。
lines.en: I am waiting, and I am very patient.

lines.zh: 这块冰是我磨出来的。
lines.en: This patch of ice is one I wore smooth.

lines.zh: 我把身子理直，又蜷回去。
lines.en: I straighten my length, then curl it back.

lines.zh: 我呼出的冷气在口器上结成霜。
lines.en: My cold breath freezes on my mandibles.

lines.zh: 远处有脚步声，踩碎了冰。
lines.en: Footsteps far off, breaking the ice.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像一截冻住的木头。
lines.en: I hold still as a length of frozen wood.

lines.zh: 我从冰下抬头，看你呼出的白气。
lines.en: I lift my head from the ice and watch your breath.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛蓝得比冰还冷。
lines.en: My eyes are a colder blue than the ice.

lines.zh: 你踩在冰上，脚下在响。
lines.en: You stand on the ice, and it complains.

lines.zh: 我先看你的靴子，再看你的脸。
lines.en: I look at your boots, then at your face.

lines.zh: 你比雪暖，我感觉得到。
lines.en: You are warmer than snow, and I feel it.

lines.zh: 我偏头，霜从甲上落下来。
lines.en: I tilt, and frost drops from my shell.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，那里有火把。
lines.en: I watch your hand, where the torch is.

lines.zh: 你站得离冰缝太近了。
lines.en: You stand too near the crevasse.

lines.zh: 我的口器张了张，没有声音。
lines.en: My mandibles part without a sound.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一块会走的热肉。
lines.en: I look at you like walking warm meat.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在我甲上，冰屑四溅。
lines.en: Your sword hits my shell and sprays ice chips.

lines.zh: 我缩了一下，霜落了一地。
lines.en: I flinch once, and frost falls everywhere.

lines.zh: 甲壳裂了，里面露出蓝白的肉。
lines.en: The shell splits and shows blue-white flesh.

lines.zh: 我流出的东西立刻冻住了。
lines.en: What leaks from me freezes at once.

lines.zh: 这一刀削掉我一截尾节。
lines.en: That cut shaves off one of my tail segments.

lines.zh: 我钻进冰里，又冲出来。
lines.en: I dive into the ice and burst out again.

lines.zh: 疼让我把身子卷成冰坨。
lines.en: Pain curls me into a lump of ice.

lines.zh: 你砍进节缝，我疼得滚了半圈。
lines.en: You cut into a seam, and I roll half a turn.

lines.zh: 我的伤口在冒白气。
lines.en: White steam rises from my wound.

lines.zh: 我甩掉冰碴，继续往前拱。
lines.en: I shake off the ice chips and keep pushing forward.

lines.zh: 你把肉放在冰上，它立刻冻住。
lines.en: You set meat on the ice, and it freezes at once.

lines.zh: 我不吃冷的，可我想吃你。
lines.en: I do not eat cold food, but I would eat you.

lines.zh: 那点热气，比食物更诱人。
lines.en: That warmth draws me more than food.

lines.zh: 你退开，冰面才不再裂。
lines.en: Only when you back away does the ice stop splitting.

lines.zh: 我探出前半身，闻了闻。
lines.en: I push my front half out and sniff.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我退了半尺。
lines.en: You raise the torch, and I pull back half a foot.

lines.zh: 肉冻成石头，我绕了过去。
lines.en: The meat freezes solid, and I go around it.

lines.zh: 我围着那块肉转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle that piece of meat once.

lines.zh: 我想要的不是肉，是你的温度。
lines.en: What I want is not meat but your heat.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住冰，肉还在冰里。
lines.en: I bite the ice, and the meat is still inside it.

lines.zh: 我的甲比冰还硬，撞上来发闷。
lines.en: My shell is harder than ice, and it lands with a thud.

lines.zh: 你撞我，霜屑落了一地。
lines.en: You hit me, and frost crumbs fall everywhere.

lines.zh: 我一扭，冰面裂成蛛网。
lines.en: I twist, and the ice cracks into a web.

lines.zh: 你踩在我背上，脚底打滑。
lines.en: You step on my back, and your feet slide.

lines.zh: 我顶你的腿，把你推向冰缝。
lines.en: I butt your leg and push you toward the crevasse.

lines.zh: 碰撞时，我身上的冷气扑了你一脸。
lines.en: At the impact, my cold air hits your face.

lines.zh: 我的节很滑，你抓不住。
lines.en: My segments are slick, and you cannot hold them.

lines.zh: 我们撞在冰柱上，冰柱断了。
lines.en: We hit an ice pillar, and it breaks.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，冰面塌了一块。
lines.en: I turn aside, and a slab of ice gives way.

lines.zh: 你退开时，呼出的气都是白的。
lines.en: When you back off, your breath is all white.

lines.zh: 两条冰虫在冰下并行。
lines.en: Two iceworms travel side by side beneath the ice.

lines.zh: 我们把雪拱成一道硬脊。
lines.en: We push the snow into one hardened ridge.

lines.zh: 它的霜比我的厚，我靠过去。
lines.en: Its frost is thicker than mine, so I press closer.

lines.zh: 冰虫相遇，只交换一点冷气。
lines.en: Iceworms meet and trade only a little cold.

lines.zh: 我们在冰柱间绕了三圈。
lines.en: We circle three times among the ice pillars.

lines.zh: 它钻进冰缝，我守在缝口。
lines.en: It slips into a crack, and I guard the mouth.

lines.zh: 冰下没有声音，只有震动。
lines.en: There is no sound under the ice, only vibration.

lines.zh: 我们的节碰在一起，叮的一声。
lines.en: Our segments touch with a small ringing note.

lines.zh: 它走了，冰面上留下两道痕。
lines.en: It leaves, and two grooves remain on the ice.

lines.zh: 分开时，霜把痕迹盖住了。
lines.en: When we part, frost covers the marks.

lines.zh: 我用口器夹起一块冰晶。
lines.en: I lift a crystal of ice in my mandibles.

lines.zh: 冰里冻着一枚旧牙，我挖出来。
lines.en: An old tooth is frozen in the ice; I dig it out.

lines.zh: 我不捡铁，铁会粘住我的甲。
lines.en: I do not pick up iron; it sticks to my shell.

lines.zh: 冻住的肉，我一节节推着走。
lines.en: I push the frozen meat along segment by segment.

lines.zh: 我拾起那块发亮的晶体，含着。
lines.en: I pick up the shining crystal and hold it.

lines.zh: 你的东西掉进冰缝，我把它顶上来。
lines.en: Your thing fell into a crack, and I push it up.

lines.zh: 我推着一块冰，滚了很远。
lines.en: I push a block of ice and it rolls far.

lines.zh: 我叼起一截冻硬的尾巴。
lines.en: I take up a stiff frozen tail.

lines.zh: 冰面下的骨头，我一节节翻出来。
lines.en: I turn up bones from under the ice, one by one.

lines.zh: 我捡东西时，霜从背上掉。
lines.en: As I pick things up, frost falls from my back.

lines.zh: 你的热气透过冰面，我找到了你。
lines.en: Your heat comes through the ice, and I find you.

lines.zh: 我从冰下抬头，呼出一口白雾。
lines.en: I rise from under the ice and breathe out white mist.

lines.zh: 你站在我的冰面上，就是目标。
lines.en: You stand on my ice, so you are the target.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向拱起一道雪脊。
lines.en: I raise a ridge of snow toward you.

lines.zh: 冰下只有你在动，那就是你。
lines.en: Yours is the only movement under the ice.

lines.zh: 我的口器张开，对着你的靴子。
lines.en: My mandibles open at your boots.

lines.zh: 你比冰暖，我不会认错。
lines.en: You are warmer than ice, and I cannot mistake it.

lines.zh: 火光晃了一下，我锁定了它。
lines.en: The torchlight wavers, and I lock onto it.

lines.zh: 你踩碎薄冰，我听见了。
lines.en: You break thin ice, and I hear it.

lines.zh: 我不挑，最近的那个就是你。
lines.en: I do not choose; the nearest one is you.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边盘了一圈，收紧了。
lines.en: I coil once around your feet and tighten.

lines.zh: 冰面开始裂，那是我的信号。
lines.en: The ice begins to crack, and that is my signal.

lines.zh: 我抬起前半身，雪从我背上落下。
lines.en: I raise my front half, and snow falls off my back.

lines.zh: 你走进这片白，就走进了我的圈。
lines.en: You walk into this white, into my circle.

lines.zh: 我在冰下跟着你，雪脊一直动。
lines.en: I follow beneath the ice, and the ridge keeps moving.

lines.zh: 你往哪走，冰就往哪裂。
lines.en: Wherever you walk, the ice splits that way.

lines.zh: 你停住不动，我便从雪里露出半节。
lines.en: You hold still, so I show half a segment from the snow.

lines.zh: 你回头看，冰面已经合上了。
lines.en: You look back, and the ice has closed again.

lines.zh: 我绕到你前面，从雪里抬头。
lines.en: I circle ahead and lift my head from the snow.

lines.zh: 你跑，我的雪脊追得更快。
lines.en: You run, and my ridge runs faster.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的脚印钻，一条不落。
lines.en: I bore along your footprints, missing none.

lines.zh: 你爬上冰柱，我绕着柱底转。
lines.en: You climb a pillar, and I circle its base.

lines.zh: 你一落地，冰就替你报了位置。
lines.en: The moment you land, the ice reports your position.

lines.zh: 我不出声，冷气替我说话。
lines.en: I make no sound; the cold speaks for me.

lines.zh: 你在雪堆后喘气，白雾露了你。
lines.en: You pant behind the snowbank, and your breath betrays you.

lines.zh: 我一直在冰下，比你深一尺。
lines.en: I am always under the ice, a foot deeper than you.

lines.zh: 你换了方向，我也换了。
lines.en: You change direction, and so do I.

lines.zh: 这片冰不大，你走不到边。
lines.en: This ice is small, and you cannot reach its edge.

lines.zh: 我从冰下窜起，咬住你的脚踝。
lines.en: I burst up through the ice and bite your ankle.

lines.zh: 我的口器合拢，霜顺着伤口爬。
lines.en: My mandibles close, and frost crawls into the wound.

lines.zh: 我把你扫倒，冰面接住了你。
lines.en: I sweep you down, and the ice catches you.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你滑出三丈远。
lines.en: One ram and you slide thirty feet.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你扔在雪堆里。
lines.en: I whip my head and throw you into the snowbank.

lines.zh: 我的节压下来，冷得刺骨。
lines.en: My segments press down, cold enough to sting.

lines.zh: 我咬空了，冰屑炸了一脸。
lines.en: I bite empty air, and ice chips burst in my face.

lines.zh: 我用尾节扫你的膝，你跪了下去。
lines.en: My tail segment sweeps your knee, and you drop.

lines.zh: 你滚下冰坡，我跟着滑。
lines.en: You roll down the ice slope, and I slide after.

lines.zh: 我咬住就往后缩，把你往冰里带。
lines.en: I bite and pull back, dragging you toward the ice.

lines.zh: 我是从蛋里出来的，冰面裂开一道口。
lines.en: I came from an egg, and the ice split open.

lines.zh: 这世界没有我的自然入口，只有人放我出来。
lines.en: This world has no natural door for me; only hands open it.

lines.zh: 我在冰窝里睁眼，四周全是霜。
lines.en: I open my eyes in an ice hollow, frost all around.

lines.zh: 我抖掉身上的冰壳，节节发亮。
lines.en: I shake off the ice shell, and each segment shines.

lines.zh: 冷气先到，我才到。
lines.en: The cold arrives first, and then I do.

lines.zh: 我出生时，雪停了。
lines.en: When I was born, the snow stopped.

lines.zh: 我从冻土里拱出来，头上有冰碴。
lines.en: I push up through frozen soil with ice on my head.

lines.zh: 这里太暖，我得先找个冰缝。
lines.en: It is too warm here; I must find a crack first.

lines.zh: 我盘着身子，等甲壳冻硬。
lines.en: I coil and wait for my shell to harden with cold.

lines.zh: 谁把我放出来，我就先找谁。
lines.en: Whoever let me out, I look for them first.

lines.zh: 火烤我的甲，冰壳化成水流下来。
lines.en: Fire heats my shell, and the ice melts and runs off.

lines.zh: 我摔在冰坡上，节节都磕响了。
lines.en: I fall on the ice slope, and every segment knocks.

lines.zh: 冰水灌进口器，我僵了一下。
lines.en: Icy water fills my mandibles, and I stiffen once.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀出冰面，甲片带着霜飞散。
lines.en: The blast throws me off the ice, frosted plates scattering.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的节，冻在了伤口上。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my segment, frozen into the wound.

lines.zh: 药水在我甲上冒烟，霜化了。
lines.en: Potion smokes on my shell, and the frost melts.

lines.zh: 我饿得身上结不出新的霜。
lines.en: Hunger stops new frost from forming on me.

lines.zh: 雷落在我背上，冰壳炸开一片。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and bursts the ice shell.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有冰，我一路往下掉。
lines.en: The void has no ice, and I fall and fall.
